prompt_text: Use the machine's discarded continuations as visible architecture.
unselected_final_words_claim: coordinates do not explain the poem they force the page to admit it was chosen by machine elsewhere
selector_vector_claim: Selected-line text selectors fetch the 18-word shadow in six three-word triplets, making character addressability part of the poem object rather than a receipt only.
non_claim: This packet validates branch bookkeeping, shadow-word construction, selected-line addressability, and selector-vector construction only; it is not a poem-quality claim.
disclosure_condition: This draft is machine-authored and packet-rendered. Disclosure is a runtime condition: without it, the selector vector reads as decoration instead of structure.
design_change_from_d003: D003 externalized the lattice but left addressability mostly as evidence. D004 makes the selector map feed a selector_vector receipt: selected line spans point to triplets of the unselected-shadow sentence.

candidates.text: Validate the feeling by its coordinates.
candidates.rejection_note: Still treats measurement as emotional substitute; shadow word: coordinates.

candidates.text: Vote for the branch the operators do.
candidates.rejection_note: Socially flat and procedural; shadow word: do.

candidates.text: Varnish the apparatus and pretend it is not.

candidates.text: Verify the line by coordinate, then distrust the coordinate.

candidates.text: Explain the hinge until it can only explain.

candidates.text: Elevate procedure until it replaces poem.
candidates.rejection_note: The exact failure this revision is resisting; shadow word: poem.

candidates.text: Each visible sentence keeps the address of what it hides.
candidates.selection_note: Keeps the surface readable while binding it to hidden structure.

layers.function: character positions become a second prosody
